questions.explanation: Buildings used as dwellings are residential.

questions.stem: Before a building can be put up in a Nigerian city, the approval of the development control authority is needed mainly to ensure that the design
options: is the cheapest possible for the client to build
complies with planning and building regulations
is drawn by the client personally
questions.explanation: Approval checks compliance with the building code, zoning and byelaws for safety and order.

questions.explanation: The structural engineer calculates and details the load-bearing structure.

questions.explanation: The site agent (site manager) runs the site for the contractor.

questions.stem: A labourer suffers a deep cut on site. The FIRST aid action is to
options: press a clean dressing on the wound
give him a cold drink and send him back to work
questions.explanation: Direct pressure with a clean dressing controls bleeding before medical help arrives.

questions.stem: Which machine is used on site to mix cement, sand, aggregate and water mechanically?
questions.explanation: A drum (concrete) mixer combines the ingredients uniformly.

questions.stem: A heavy machine with a broad front blade used to push away bushes and level ground is the
questions.explanation: The bulldozer is used for clearing and rough grading.

questions.stem: Temporary buildings put up on site to serve as stores and offices for the contractor are called
questions.explanation: Hutments are temporary site huts for offices, stores and welfare.

questions.stem: A rectangular building is 9 m wide and 12 m long. To check that it is square, each diagonal should measure
questions.explanation: Diagonal = √(9² + 12²) = √225 = 15 m; equal diagonals confirm square corners.

questions.stem: The point of known height on a site from which all levels are taken is the
questions.explanation: A datum or temporary bench mark gives the reference level for all heights.

questions.stem: A wall 75 mm long on a drawing at a scale of 1 : 50 is actually
A drawing that shows the building as if cut through vertically, revealing heights of floors, walls and roof, is a
questions.explanation: A sectional drawing shows the internal construction on a vertical cutting plane.

questions.stem: Auto-CADD is used in building drawing mainly to
options: set out buildings on site without pegs or lines
produce and edit drawings on a computer
questions.explanation: CAD software allows accurate drawings that are easy to change, copy and print.

questions.stem: Twelve column pits each 1.2 m x 1.2 m x 1.5 m deep are dug. If the soil bulks by 25% when dug, the loose volume to be carted away is about
questions.explanation: Solid volume = 12 x 1.2 x 1.2 x 1.5 = 25.92 m³; loose = 25.92 x 1.25 = 32.4 m³.

questions.stem: Pumping water out of an excavation in waterlogged ground so that work can continue is called
questions.explanation: Dewatering removes ground water from trenches and pits.

questions.stem: Isolated pad foundations are MOST suitable for
options: framed buildings where loads come down through columns
continuous load-bearing walls of a bungalow
very weak soil over the whole site
questions.explanation: Pads spread concentrated column loads to the soil.

questions.stem: Which factor does NOT directly affect the choice of foundation for a building?
options: The bearing capacity of the soil
The level of the water table
The colour of the roofing sheets
questions.explanation: Soil strength, loads, water table and structure type govern foundation choice; roof colour does not.

questions.stem: Hardcore under a solid ground floor slab is provided mainly to
options: act as the final floor finish in living rooms
give a firm, level base and reduce capillary rise
questions.explanation: Compacted hardcore provides a stable base and breaks capillary rise of moisture.

questions.stem: Compared with a building without a basement, a building with a basement needs special
options: tanking or waterproofing against ground water
questions.explanation: Basement walls and floors are below ground level, so they must be tanked against water pressure.

questions.stem: In a reinforced concrete suspended floor, the main steel bars are placed near the
options: top surface of the slab only
bottom of the slab where tension occurs
questions.explanation: Under load the underside of a simply supported slab is in tension, which steel resists.

questions.stem: The process of keeping fresh concrete moist for some days so that it gains strength is
questions.explanation: Curing keeps water available for the hydration of cement.

Crushed periwinkle shells are used in some coastal areas of Nigeria in concrete as
questions.explanation: Periwinkle shells (like palm kernel shells) are locally available lightweight coarse aggregates.

questions.stem: The test in which concrete cubes are crushed after 7 and 28 days is the
questions.explanation: Cube crushing gives compressive strength; slump measures workability of fresh concrete.

questions.stem: The main function of a lintel over a window opening is to
options: carry the load of the wall above the opening
keep rain off the window glass
questions.explanation: The lintel spans the opening and transfers the load above to the jambs.

questions.stem: A mortar mix of 1 : 6 by volume requires 0.7 m³ of dry materials. The volume of cement needed is
questions.explanation: Cement = 1/7 x 0.7 = 0.1 m³; sand = 0.6 m³.

questions.stem: A window that is hinged at the top so that it opens outward at the bottom is a
questions.explanation: Top-hung (awning) windows pivot on hinges at the head.

The pit that receives the liquid that flows out of a septic tank and lets it soak into the ground is the
questions.explanation: Effluent from the septic tank passes to a soakaway pit that disperses it into the soil.

questions.topic: Electrical Installation and Solar Energy System
questions.stem: In a solar energy system for a house, the device that converts the d.c. from batteries to 230 V a.c. is the
questions.explanation: An inverter changes d.c. to a.c. for household appliances.

options: an air terminal connected to earth by a down conductor

questions.stem: Ceramic floor tiles are fixed to the screed with
questions.explanation: Tiles are bedded on adhesive or mortar and the joints grouted.

questions.stem: Spraying or throwing a wet mix of cement, sand and small stones onto an external wall to give a rough finish is
questions.explanation: Rough-cast is a textured rendering applied by throwing the mix with stones in it.

questions.stem: Which of these is used as a ceiling finishing material?
questions.explanation: PVC panels, POP and gypsum or asbestos-free boards are ceiling finishes.

questions.stem: Planting grass and shrubs and shaping the ground around a completed building is called
questions.explanation: Landscaping improves appearance and controls erosion around the building.

questions.topic: Types of Business Organization and Ways of Raising Capital

questions.explanation: A sole proprietor owns and runs the business alone with unlimited liability.

questions.stem: The book of original entry in which a builder records all money received and paid out is the
questions.explanation: The cash book records cash and bank receipts and payments.

questions.stem: A contract in which the contractor agrees to do the whole job for a fixed total price is a
questions.explanation: Lump-sum contracts fix the price for the defined work.

questions.stem:
(a) Define safety as applied to building construction. [2 marks]
(b) State five hazards on a building site. [5 marks]
(c) State four precautions when working with scaffolding. [4 marks]
(d) List four items that should be in a site first aid box. [4 marks]
questions.markingGuide:
2 marks: (a) practices and measures to prevent accidents, injury and damage on site
5 marks: (b) any five: falls from height, falling objects, open excavations, electricity, moving plant, cement burns, sharp objects/nails, collapsing formwork (1 each)
4 marks: (c) any four: firm base plates/sole boards, guard rails and toe boards, ties to building, inspect regularly, do not overload, competent erector (1 each)
4 marks: (d) any four: sterile dressings, bandages, plaster, antiseptic, gloves, scissors, eye wash (1 each)
questions.explanation: Safety is preventing harm. Hazards: falls, falling objects, trenches, electricity, plant, cement. Scaffolds need firm bases, rails, ties and inspection. First aid box: dressings, bandages, antiseptic, gloves, scissors.

questions.stem:
(a) Explain the terms (i) timbering, (ii) battering, (iii) dewatering. [6 marks]
(b) A trench for a strip foundation is 32 m long (centre line), 0.75 m wide and 1.2 m deep. Calculate (i) the volume of excavation, (ii) the volume of concrete for a 225 mm thick strip footing at the bottom, (iii) the loose volume of excavated soil if bulking is 20%. [6 marks]
(c) State three safety rules for excavation. [3 marks]
questions.markingGuide:
2 marks: (a)(i) timbering: supporting trench sides with planks, struts and walings to prevent collapse
2 marks: (a)(ii) battering: sloping the trench sides to a safe angle
2 marks: (a)(iii) dewatering: removing ground water from the excavation by pumping or well points
2 marks: (b)(i) 32 x 0.75 x 1.2 = 28.8 m³
2 marks: (b)(ii) 32 x 0.75 x 0.225 = 5.4 m³
2 marks: (b)(iii) 28.8 x 1.2 = 34.56 m³
3 marks: (c) any three: barriers around trench, ladders for access, keep spoil and plant away from edge, inspect supports daily, no one working alone in deep trench (1 each)
questions.explanation: Timbering supports, battering slopes, dewatering pumps out water. Excavation 28.8 m³; concrete 5.4 m³; loose soil 34.56 m³. Safety: barriers, ladders, spoil away from edge, inspections.

questions.stem:
(a) Define concrete and name its constituent materials. [3 marks]
(b) Describe four stages in producing concrete on site. [8 marks]
(c) Describe how the slump test is carried out. [4 marks]
questions.markingGuide:
1 mark: (a) concrete: mixture of binder, aggregates and water that hardens into a stone-like mass
2 marks: (a) cement, fine aggregate (sand), coarse aggregate (gravel/granite), water (any four for 2 marks)
2 marks: (b) batching: measuring materials by volume or weight
2 marks: (b) mixing: by hand or machine to uniform colour/consistency
2 marks: (b) transporting and placing in formwork without segregation
2 marks: (b) compacting with vibrator/rodding, then curing for at least 7 days
1 mark: (c) fill slump cone in three layers on a level base
1 mark: (c) rod each layer 25 times
1 mark: (c) strike off level and lift cone vertically
1 mark: (c) measure drop of concrete from cone height = slump
questions.explanation: Concrete combines cement, sand, coarse aggregate and water. Production: batch, mix, transport and place, compact, cure. Slump: three layers rodded 25 times, lift cone, measure subsidence.

questions.stem:
(a) Define the following: (i) tread, (ii) riser, (iii) nosing, (iv) landing. [4 marks]
(b) A staircase rises 2.80 m from floor to floor. Using risers not exceeding 180 mm and the rule 2R + G = 600 mm, calculate (i) the number of risers, (ii) the actual rise of each step, (iii) the going, (iv) the number of treads in a straight flight. [8 marks]
(c) State three materials used for constructing stairs. [3 marks]
questions.markingGuide:
1 mark: (a)(i) tread: horizontal upper surface of a step
1 mark: (a)(ii) riser: vertical face between two treads
1 mark: (a)(iii) nosing: front edge of tread projecting over riser
1 mark: (a)(iv) landing: platform between flights or at the top
2 marks: (b)(i) 2800/180 = 15.6, so 16 risers
2 marks: (b)(ii) rise = 2800/16 = 175 mm
2 marks: (b)(iii) going = 600 - 2 x 175 = 250 mm
2 marks: (b)(iv) treads = risers - 1 = 15
3 marks: (c) any three: reinforced concrete, timber, steel, stone/terrazzo (1 each)
questions.explanation: 2800/180 = 15.6 so 16 risers of 175 mm; going 250 mm; 15 treads. Stairs are made of concrete, timber, steel or stone.

questions.stem:
(a) State four functional requirements of a roof. [4 marks]
(b) Name four roof covering materials used in Nigeria. [4 marks]
(c) Describe three ways of protecting a pitched roof against wind uplift. [6 marks]
(d) What is a wall plate? [1 mark]
questions.markingGuide:
4 marks: (a) any four: strength and stability, weather resistance, thermal insulation, fire resistance, durability, good appearance, drainage of rain (1 each)
4 marks: (b) any four: aluminium sheets, long-span roofing, stone-coated steel tiles, corrugated iron sheets, clay tiles, thatch, concrete tiles (1 each)
2 marks: (c) anchor wall plate to wall with straps/bolts cast into the ring beam
2 marks: (c) fix rafters/trusses to wall plate with metal straps or hurricane clips
2 marks: (c) fix sheets with adequate roofing nails/screws at correct spacing; limit eaves overhang
1 mark: (d) timber member on top of wall receiving rafters/trusses and spreading their load
questions.explanation: Roofs must be strong, weatherproof, insulating, fire-resistant and durable. Coverings: aluminium, long-span, stone-coated tiles, clay tiles. Uplift resisted by anchoring wall plate, strapping trusses and adequate fixing of sheets.

questions.stem:
(a) Name three parties to a building contract. [3 marks]
(b) Distinguish between a lump-sum contract and a cost-plus contract. [4 marks]
(c) State four contents of the bill of quantities or other contract documents. [4 marks]
(d) State four duties of the contractor under a building contract. [4 marks]
questions.markingGuide:
3 marks: (a) employer/client, contractor, architect/consultant (or quantity surveyor) (1 each)
2 marks: (b) lump-sum: fixed total price for defined work
2 marks: (b) cost-plus: contractor paid actual cost plus agreed fee/percentage
4 marks: (c) any four: contract drawings, specification, bill of quantities, conditions of contract, form of tender/agreement (1 each)
4 marks: (d) any four: execute work according to drawings and specification, complete on time, provide labour/materials/plant, insure works, keep site safe, remedy defects (1 each)
questions.explanation: Parties: client, contractor, architect. Lump-sum fixes price; cost-plus reimburses cost plus fee. Documents: drawings, specification, BOQ, conditions, agreement. Contractor executes work to specification, on time, safely, with insurance and defect remedy.
